title: Saved person login survives gateway restart and refresh
description: Use an owned signed-in Agent Chrome browser context from prove-saved-login-restart.mjs create/signin, with explicit QA profile/principal. Operator coordinates exactly the approved restarts through wait-deploy-quiet and dev-gateway-update, including slot-maintenance acknowledgement. This recipe performs only the post-restart document reload and asserts the same signed-in principal, no auth prompt. It never reads Chrome storage or performs a gateway restart. Env FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT and FARMSLOT_LOGIN_PROOF_{OUTPUT,URL,PRINCIPAL,LABEL}.

refresh-saved-login.intent: Reload the actual signed-in document after the coordinated restart and verify that the saved login is reused.
